findings.summary: T3 lacks formal predicates, quantifiers, and an exhaustive execution-model split
the physical speculation window undercounts completed but unpublished work in an atomic candidate batch
the native internal-parallel batch bypasses the Python ordered speculation window
Qmax and Cmax are declared inputs rather than measured and receipt-bound runtime quantities
the per-candidate TLA model is not related to the aggregate Python CandidateTxn by a simulation proof
the checked configurations contain safety invariants but no liveness property or fairness assumption

required_corrections: define the T3 state generator, canonical serial trace, predicates, quantifiers, and allowed scheduler class
bind T4 W to the whole uncommitted transaction or enforce an admission/commit boundary that is no larger than W
measure and bind Qmax, Cmax, native batch size, and physical parallelism to receipts
supply a batch-to-candidate refinement relation or change the formal model to the runtime transaction granularity
bind the proof and mapping hashes in an independent successor review receipt
